extracted.name: Jenny Chicken Souse
extracted.description: Great recipe for Jenny Chicken Souse.
ingredient_lines: 1 3-4 lb chicken cut into 8-10 pieces or chicken parts
instruction_lines: Soak wings in vinegar and water for 10 mins. Rinse
Add chicken, celery, onion, all spice, bay leaves, garlic, goat pepper, salt to a large pot
Add 2 cups water and boil for 15 mins
Add potatoes and 6 cups water. Cover and cook for 40 mins on medium heat
Spoon fat off the surface. Use spoon to break apart chicken legs. Add additional salt and lime to taste
